scope: The local address is used for camera and FTPS files, even when the camera is disabled. Commands stay on the cloud account; the printer mode is unchanged.
invalid: Invalid configuration or save rejected. Use a private IPv4 without URL or port.
hybrid: Experimental · Cloud telemetry + LAN camera · RTSPS transport. The server needs a route to the local network.
camera-experimental-disabled: Hybrid camera has not been enabled by the server administrator.
camera-disabled: Camera disabled. Cloud monitoring remains available.
camera-cloud-unqualified: Remote Cloud video is not qualified. No remote transport is started.
camera-host-required: A local address is required to try LAN video with this Cloud account.
